senses.gloss:
Khagapati_Agrihotrin
a Kānyakubja brahmin, of Pāṭamapura; father of Mallaśarman (a. of Hastasvaraprakriyā, written in 1724 A. D. Bomb. Uni. 725, RASB. II. 912).

Khagapati
--Śābdabhedanidarśana. vedalakṣaṇa. in 12 verses. PUL. II. p. 24.

Khagaprakāśa
jy. by Rāmadaivajña. Mysore I. p. 332 (with C. an. chart).

Khagapraśnasaṃhitā
from Pāñcarātra. MT. 6469 (17th ch. Jayantīnirṇaya).
See below Khagendraº an. Khageśvaraº.
C.. Gāruḍa, Tārkṣya an. Vihagendra Saṁhitās.

Khagavilāsa
jy. by Nirbhaya Rāmabhaṭṭa. Udaipur II. 184, 18.

Khagondranātha
ref. to by Jayaratha in his C. on Abhinavagupta's Tantrāloka, Kas. Texts 57. ch. 29. p. 3.

Khagendrasaṃhitā
extracted in Pāñcarātrāgama. MT. 3257 (Adhy. 15 Sudarśanahomārcana).
C.. Gāruḍa. Tārkṣya an. Vihagendra Saṁhitās. [Page170-b]

Khageśvaraśānti
dh. relates to the evil of a vulture coming an. sitting in one's house. Baudh. Burnell 149a. TD. 13385. 13386.

Khageśvarasaṃhitā
dh.
--Śrīcūrṇapratiṣṭhāvidhi from. on a preliminary ceremony in connection with the funeral rite of Śrīvaiṣṇavas. MD. 3830.
Q. in Vilakṣaṇādhikārinirṇaya, Adyar D. X. 461 (Extr.) (Garuḍa is a. interlocutor).
C.. above Khagendraº; also Gāruḍa, Tārkṣya an. Vihagendra Saṁhitās.
